scope: 12 new locally authored synthetic Draw.io tasks, created after Stage D calibration and unseen by the generation model. This is not an externally independent final holdout.
acceptancePolicy: Use only the sibling pre-run acceptance-policy-v2.json; no Stage D post-hoc policy is eligible.
reviewRequirement: Two named reviewers must approve every source/evidence/claim package before a model call.
stoppingRule: After reviewer approval and explicit model authorization, run the frozen cohort once. Do not tune prompts, model parameters, task data, sources, assertions, evaluator or policy after observing output.
